description: Create MANY managed codes in a single request — up to 500. Use this for any batch: stickers for a print run, one code per table or shelf, one per branch or partner. Results are per item, so one bad URL does not sink the batch: the reply is {created, reused, failed, data:[…]} where each entry is either a code (ok=true, plus `reused` telling you whether it already existed) or {ok:false, external_ref, error}. On a re-run after a partial failure `created` counts only what was actually new and `reused` counts what was returned unchanged, so the two numbers tell you whether the call did any work. Give every item an external_ref — the call is then idempotent per item and safe to re-run after a partial failure, without producing duplicates. Bulk requires a paid plan: on a free workspace it answers HTTP 402 plan_required, and the fallback is a loop of qrtap_create_code within the plan's limits.

design_template_id.description: Optional branded design template id (UUID) from qrtap_list_design_templates.

external_ref.description: Your own identifier for this code (branch code, SKU, partner id, table number), max 200 chars. Two things depend on it: creation is idempotent by external_ref, so re-running the same call returns the existing code instead of minting a duplicate; and qrtap_list_codes can look a code up by it later. Always set it for batches — it is what makes a retry safe.

group.description: Analytics bucket for this code, one of: partner | equipment | event_menu | bag_insert | training. Codes sharing a group can be totalled in one call with qrtap_group_stats, so set it whenever a code belongs to a batch (a branch, a partner, an event).

title.description: Human-readable label shown in the cabinet (max 160).

name: qrtap_create_codes_bulk
